name: Confusion
overview: The Scriptures reveal that confusion arose when humanity, united by one language and speech, sought to build a city and a tower reaching to heaven to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered (Genesis 11:1-4). Observing this, the LORD came down and recognized their singular language and purpose, which enabled them to achieve anything they imagined (Genesis 11:5-6). This account underscores how God sovereignly intervened to disrupt human plans by introducing confusion of tongues, thereby scattering people across the earth and preventing their unified rebellion.
